title: JD Vance says he won't watch livestream execution of Fort Hood shooter
summary: Vice President JD Vance said Friday he won't watch a potential livestream of the convicted Fort Hood shooter's execution, which President Trump told reporters he had approved. Why it matters: Vance questioned whether the execution would actually be public but joined a small chorus of Republicans opposed to watching the execution, which is set to be conducted by a firing squad in December. What they're saying: "Whatever the controversy is about the method of the execution, I hope that people don't forget that this is a guy who brutally murdered a lot of innocent people," Vance told reporters on Friday. summary: 2020 was an annus horribilis. Covid stalked the land. Lockdowns, curfews and social distancing were the order of the day. But there was a silver lining: European countries showed themselves to be capable of great solidarity, jointly procuring vaccines and then agreeing on a mammoth post-Covid recovery fund, the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF). title: Decommissioned plane gets stuck under bridge near Bucharest
summary: A decommissioned passenger plane became stuck beneath a bridge on Romania’s DN1 road overnight in the Balotești area, north of Bucharest, Digi24 reported. The aircraft, which had its wings removed for transport, was travelling from Bucharest Henri Coandă International Airport to Voluntari. One traffic lane was blocked while crews worked to clear the road. The plane was subsequently moved to a nearby car park. Images of the aircraft stuck under the bridge were shared on social media. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6XKYACd5qkQ According to media reports, the authorities plan to resume the journey overnight after making changes to the vehicle and equipment used to transport the aircraft.

title: Bison found dead and decapitated in Romania, police investigate suspected poaching
summary: A bison was found decapitated in the area of Ilva Mare, Bistrița-Năsăud County, by locals on Thursday, October 8. A day later, an animal protection association, Ramses, filed a complaint with the police, and a criminal file was opened. The bison is a protected species in Romania. "A body without a head and questions to which the authorities must find answers. The Ramses Association has filed a complaint requesting that the perpetrator be identified and demanding the maximum prison sentence provided by law, to be served, for the illegal killing of this animal," officials of the Ramses Association said in a post on Facebook. https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=122172621038713104&set=pb.615
